agent_explanation: Controller balances pole (theta stays ~-0.06 to -0.08, margin ~0.72) with only ~0.3-0.8 force, far below 50.4 limit, but applies insufficient cart-position correction to overcome initial x=-0.45, v=-0.287 drift.
